title: Kissed Garlicky Thai Fish Balls Kanom Jeen
description: A garlicky and pillowy Thai dish featuring fish balls served with applesauce and kanom jeen noodles, providing a nostalgic and anti-inflammatory friendly meal option.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the kanom jeen noodles according to package instructions.
Shock the cooked noodles in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Cut the garlic into thin slices and saute in vegetable oil until fragrant.
Add the fish balls to the garlic oil and cook until lightly browned.
Combine the fish sauce and lime juice in a small bowl and stir to combine.
Add the sauce to the fish balls and garlic oil, and stir to coat.
Serve the fish balls over the kanom jeen noodles with a side of applesauce.
Drizzle any remaining sauce over the top of the dish and serve immediately.
